question: Th7/2025 đh bị huỹ chiếm bnhiu %?
sql:
SELECT ROUND(
                COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (TRY_CAST(trang_thai AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%hủy%' OR TRY_CAST(trang_thai AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%huỷ%' OR TRY_CAST(trang_thai AS VARCHAR) ILIKE '%cancel%') THEN ma_don_hang END) * 100.0 /
                NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ma_don_hang), 0), 2
            )
            FROM so_chi_tiet_ban_hang
            WHERE strftime(TRY_CAST(ngay AS DATE), '%Y-%m') = '2025-07'
